rationale: The strengthened target is faithful-equivalent to the selected Lp Banach assertion. Its real-valued Lp carrier is a subtype of an explicit almost-everywhere quotient, resolving the implicit convention necessary for source normhood. The ENNReal exponent with 1 ≤ p covers every finite p ≥ 1 and ⊤; eLpNorm uses the moment branch at finite p and essential supremum at ⊤, while Lp membership guarantees finiteness before toReal. The conjunction then supplies normed additive and real normed-space structure, identifies the canonical norm with that Lp formula for every element, and asserts completeness of all of Lp. Thus each statement implies the other under the source's standard Lp convention, with no reduced domain, omitted endpoint, missing completeness clause, or unintended vacuity.
